manifesto.one: I design product and I write the front-end of what I design. That isn't range: the interface decision and the cost of building it are one conversation, and splitting them across two chairs invents a third problem.
manifesto.two: The work I want has a hard domain — clinical records, energy contracts, sales training. There the screen is the smallest part: what decides is the rule, the state, and the case nobody drew.
manifesto.three: And I measure what I ship. Contrast is the worst frame, not the average; a budget is a number that has already failed something of mine. This site is the piece and the instrument in one place.
